game_start.intro: Tura tewwi tayri. Abaraz n ussuɣ : {trump_suit} (tanebdit n ussuɣ : {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Kem aɣelluy {player_id} deg Whist alman.
{phase_info}
Tettekka {hand_size} tikdiwin.
Sekcem tanebdit s '[play N]', deg tazwara N d tamnaḍt n tanebdit deg yidukku (s tɛaz, '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: TASWALT n uselmed: win irebḥen deg yal taḥerfit ad yeṭṭef takarḍa-nni yettwafernen, ma d win ur neqbil ara a yeddem tikarḍa nniḍen. Tiɣawsiwin id yewwi umdan di teswilt agi wer ttettwakalen ɣer tezmert akken ad yerbeḥ.
player_prompt.phase_playing: TAMURT: d-yeffeɣ akk uḥric n tkerkas. yal taẓrigt seg tura ad tili ɣer rrbeḥ.

next_card.playing_phase: Ulac takarḍa i d-yettunefken - tebda tneqlit n wurar.
next_card.deck_empty: Aḍebsi-nni d ilem - ulac takarḍa ara yettunefken.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Asebter n umussu ur nelli ara d win. Seqdec "[play N]" akken ad turareḍ takarḍa tis-nṭis deg ufus-ik.
invalid_move.bad_position: Amkan-nni n tkarḍa ur yelli ara. Teṭṭfeḍ {hand_size} n tkerḍiwin.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Ilaq ad tḍefreḍ amentel-nni u ad turareḍ takarḍa n {lead_suit}.

trick.won_learning: Aɣelluy {winner_id} yettwassen tanebdit s {card} d yekkes tanebdit yettwassnen.

phase.learning_complete: Yewweḍ lεali. Tfuk temsirt n uselmed - yal taḥerṣit i d-yeqqimen tettwaḥsab ɣer rrbeḥ.

draw.winner_preview: Tacarḍa i d-yettunefken deffir waya, d {card}.

trick_view.empty: Mazal ur d-yuri ara lmeṣnuε agi.
